title: pouteria obtusifolia var. parvifolia
intro: Pouteria obtusifolia var. parvifolia, commonly known as Mexican laurel or Palo de Aguila, is a plant species in the family Sapotaceae. The Mexican laurel has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to exhibit analgesic, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, making it useful in treating a range of health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Pouteria obtusifolia var. parvifolia include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
